notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached, no hardware run is claimed, and the upstream MJX environment and the real mujoco engine were not run. WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[1], ppo_train/go2_training/mujoco_playground/_src/locomotion/go2/xmls/scene_mjx_feetonly_flat_terrain.xml, as a MujocoDriver in simulated R0. The card's models[0] is the bowl scene, which no Python module of the clone references; the card's entry Joystick defaults to task=flat_terrain (joystick.py:83-87), go2_constants.py:5-19 maps flat_terrain to this scene, and the registry entry Go2JoystickFlatTerrain builds it (locomotion/__init__.py:16-22), so models[1] is the scene of the confirmed entry. cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [12]}}; the bridge checks each control against the model's actuator_ctrlrange before data.ctrl, then runs mj_step ticks times. All twelve position actuators inherit the joint ranges via inheritrange=1 (go2_mjx_feetonly.xml:13,15-24): four abduction +-1.0472 rad, four hip -1.5708 to 3.4907 rad and four knee -2.7227 to -0.83776 rad. cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults (mj_resetData + mj_forward); the state is the bridge's time_ms/qpos/qvel/ctrl/tick/timestep_ms/seed. No Limit is hand-copied, every actuator is bounded, so there is no site-limits.example.json. WHY NOT THE MjxEnv: the confirmed Joystick object is an MJX/Brax MjxEnv whose step takes a normalized action and returns mjx_env.State; the SDK has no MJX family, and jax, mujoco-mjx and the bundled mujoco_playground are not installed where the gate runs. The MuJoCo family serves the model underneath with raw ctrl, which is the card's candidate step/reset contract. NOT COVERED: the environment's normalized action (home pose + action_scale * action), command sampling, reward terms, observation vector, delay buffers, domain randomization, fall termination and the home-keyframe randomized reset are not served; the fidelity gaps list them. The bridge reset is mj_resetData (model defaults), not Joystick.reset. FAKE: backends['fake'] is a package-local stand-in for the mujoco module (fake.py), not MuJoCo; it parses the scene and its include, follows the MJCF default class chain, derives the twelve ctrlranges from inheritrange and the 4 ms timestep from the option element, and integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated hinge. Its published contract is F0; fidelity_by_backend['sim'] declares the F1 real-engine contract, which was not run. WARNINGS: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because a MuJoCo family fake is a stand-in for the engine rather than a package class the gate can wrap in a Recorder, and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed, which the bridge derives without units; PLAYBOOK section 8 calls these expected for Gymnasium and MuJoCo drivers. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver and adds six cases (model shape from the scene and its include, the inherited control-range refusals with zero effect, a step moving the hinges and advancing 4 ms per tick, reset to the model defaults, the published F0 fidelity contract, and the e-stop latch); they pass. No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used, both catalogue classes. The clone was not modified and no file outside the package was written.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Reviewed the pinned Go2 scene, all actuator channels and inherited bounds, both entry symbols, fake reset/step semantics, stop behavior, provenance and licence without running upstream code. Corrected driver.py and facts.md so the home-pose initialization and delayed-action mapping are supported by their own cited ranges. Regenerated reference.json and REFERENCE.md; check-report.json records a passing fake gate, and strict collection passes with only the documented MuJoCo stand-in/unit notes. Evidence remains contract_checked. For the human reviewer: This serves only the raw flat-terrain MJCF scene, not the Joystick MJX task or its rewards, randomization and action mapping. The analytic fake is F0; the implicit real MuJoCo route is F1 and was not run. The Airbot Play and real-robot deployment paths are outside this package.
